extension.description: Otaku Prime connects AniList, MyAnimeList, Kitsu, and Simkl and stores their raw watchlist snapshots locally.

extension.summary: A controller-first Jellyfin/Plex inspired Kodi interface.
extension.description: Jellyfin UI is a native Kodi skin designed around Jellyfin-style media browsing and Plex Media Player-style ten-foot navigation. It works with Kodi library content, Jellyfin for Kodi synced libraries, and well-formed video add-ons such as Otaku Prime.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Jellyfin, Plex, or Kodi.
